items.title: Mortgage Rates Simply Trying to Limit the Damage Right Now
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: The best way to sum up mortgage rates right now is any “good news” is simply stopping the bleeding. You’re not seeing sizable drops when positive stuff happens. items.content: Just as it appeared there was no relief in sight for mortgage rates, the Treasury Department stepped in. items.title: Mortgage Rates Catch a Break as Job Growth Goes Negative
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: The July jobs report just came out and it was very ugly. So ugly that the number of jobs created was negative instead of positive. items.title: Mortgage Rates Move Higher on Jobs Report Defense
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Mortgage rates moved higher again today on the eve of the July jobs report. The monthly jobs report from the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) is always the biggest potential mover of mortgage rates.
